title: Oracle Morning Brief
script_summary:
Bitcoin holds steady at sixty-three thousand three hundred seven, up zero point six percent in twenty-four hours, even as the Fear and Greed index sits at thirty-one. The hashrate remains robust at one thousand twenty-five EH/s, signaling miner conviction despite the cautious sentiment.

Asia session delivered modest gains with low volatility, as the mempool cleared seventy-eight thousand transactions at a minimal one sat per vbyte fee. Block height now sits at nine hundred sixty-two thousand ei
